title: Cyber Defenders Intro · Welcome to the Post Office (6-8)

items.q: How does the Magpie make trouble at the post office now?
choices: It closed the post office, and Pim retired
A whole flock helps it copy real letters and fake the postmarks
It moved away, so the post is fully safe now
It only sends letters that carry its own name
items.why: The Magpie no longer works alone: its flock copies real letters and fakes the postmarks, so each fake looks almost right.

items.q: Why is saying it will never happen to me not a defense?
choices: Because only unlucky people are ever targeted online
Because attacks stop once you feel confident about them
Because a defense is a system, and hoping is not a system
Because every message is checked by the Magpie first
items.why: A defense is a system that works even on a bad day. Hoping it never happens is not a system.

items.q: What is each step in this course made of?
choices: Story slides, then words, a quick check, and a mission
A long test, then a video, then free time to play
One game level, repeated until the time runs out
A lecture, a worksheet, and a stamp for showing up
items.why: Every step follows the same shape: story, new words, a quick check, then the mission.
